project-information.description:
### Share the essentials about the show!
To help other presenting organizations envision the tour project, share some key information: show content, presentation conditions, budget, and artistic team contacts. These essential details will give your project visibility and make it easier for potential partners to identify.

Enter the information you know for your project. You can invite the artistic team to join the project to fill in the information that concerns them and organize the tour as best as possible.

This information will be visible to everyone.

Type the first letters of your show title. If it already exists, it will automatically appear in the input field.

calendar.empty:
If you propose or join a project on CooProg, it is with the primary aim of reducing the ecological impact of artistic mobility. Together with other interested users and the producer, you will be looking for the best possible way of getting around, so as to : 

1. reduce the length of journeys between each performance as much as possible 
2. avoid round trips between the artistic teams' homes and the touring venues. 

----

If you would like to propose a cooperative project:

1. search for the project on the platform to check that it is not already there. If it is, join that project rather than create a new one;
2. Enter your project here so that registered users can be informed of your intention - don't hesitate to indicate your flexibility with regards to the dates indicated in order to facilitate the positioning of other users; 
3. Your project is now visible to the community!
4. Draw the attention of your favourite contacts by letting them know of your intention. 
5. You'll receive notifications when other users position themselves on your project.
6. Once other users have positioned themselves on the tour, contact them, as well as the show's producer, so that we can work together to achieve the optimum traffic flow defined above; 
7. Don't forget to update your project schedule based on these exchanges, so that others can join you later.

tour-information.description:
**Let's organize the tour!**

**Create a tour for each planned period around your performance dates.** Specify the estimated start and end dates (month and year), a label, and a few key milestones.

This information will help other partners, whether they are Cooprog members or not, to better coordinate and enrich the tour project. **Good planning is the key to successful cooperation!**

**If you are working on two distinct periods** (e.g., fall and spring, or October year N and April year N+1), remember to create **two separate tours**.
tour-information.name: Tour name
tour-information.name-helper:
Give a name to your tour, by instance : "Spring 2026 - Roaming Switzerland", "Octobre 2027 - Belgium Tour"...

Don't worry, you can modify the tour name later, or let the artistic team do it.
tour-information.dates-explanation: Indicate the approximate month and year of the tour you are creating.
tour-information.logistic-explanation:
These logistics-related details are used to calculate the reduction in carbon impact generated by co-programming.
This allows us to estimate the distances traveled and deduce the carbon footprint of transporting people and materials.
tour-information.decorations-help:
### Help
#### Volume reference points
:pickup_truck: 3 m³ ~= small utility van
:minibus: 6 m³ ~= medium van
:articulated_lorry: 12 m³ ~= large panel van
:truck: 20 m³ ~= 20 m³ truck
:ship: 80 m³ ~= semi-trailer

#### Weight reference points
:performing_arts: Light sets: 150 to 300 kg / m³
:loud_sound: Technical equipment: 300 to 500 kg / m³
:wood: Heavy sets: 500 to 800 kg / m³
tour-information.artistic-team-localization-helper: Enter here the location that seems most relevant for planning a tour: the departure point of the artistic team, the residence of the majority of the artistic team, the main departure location, the central point, etc.
tour-information.people-transport-helper: The primary mode of transport is used to determine carbon emissions per kilometer. If multiple modes of transport are used, select the one that best represents the environmental impact of your tour.
